pages: Lass, cutting down scoundrels like that is easy enough, but...
Their kind are a stubborn lot.
Wipe 'em out all you like, they just keep popping up like pig dung.
With pigs that ravage your fields, rather than hack at their rumps...
It's easier to toss out some feed and lure 'em away!
Besides, gahahaha!
I like that fellow!
With fun guys like him around, this world never gets boring!
Gahahaha!
Well now, Beijing at long last!
Lass, put their bill on my tab too!
I couldn't bring back a true man, but...
Minmin, Dahu! I've got plenty of tales to tell you!
Let's move it, boys! Straight to Paris, city of flowers!
Yessir!
Huh...? Haven't I seen that old guy somewhere before...?
Eh, whatever!
Wait for me! Boooss!
All right, boys! Are you ready?!
Today's the day we bust into the Palace of Versailles!
GFFF!
The day has finally come, boss!
We've done our homework! We're all set!
GFF...
This is a whole different scale from the chump change...
...we've been swiping from Paris rich folks...
We're about to sneak into the treasure vault...
...of the Bourbon royal family!
In this whole wide world, nobody pulls a heist this bold...
...except the Earthquake gang!
Don't you screw this up, you hear?!
Y-yeah!
All right...
We hop this fence and sneak right in...
Hey, Kinzo!
Fence-tastic, boss!
Was that supposed to be a joke...?
Huh?
W-well, never mind...
Just like we planned, you go distract the gatekeepers...
Got it?
You got it!
R-right!
L-listen up, you guys!
I ain't some shady character, see?! Right?!
You get that, don't ya?! Huh?
Okay, if you get it, I'll let you off easy...
So then...
I'll show you a fancy dish you couldn't afford in a lifetime!
Subuta! Sweet and sour pork!
A real fancy feast, made all the way over in Beijing, China!
'Sour pork for the gatekeeper,' they say!
My dear departed granny used to say that all the time!
Eat this and behave yourselves for a while,
got it?!
Go on, eat! Eat it!
Don't be shy! Here!
...It kinda smells sour.
Geez, you country bumpkins are hopeless!
It's called sweet and SOUR pork 'cause it's sour!
Is that the point? This stuff's gone bad...
Y-y-y-you guys! You got a problem with my cooking?!
...If you say so, then you eat it.
Fine! You guys ain't getting a single bite now!
Don't come begging for some later!
Munch munch...
...Burp...
Ahh, that was good!
Hehehe... I ate the whole thing!
Serves you right!
Y-you idiot!
Didn't we tell you?!
Sounds like things are getting rowdy at the gate.
Heheh... Looks like Kinzo pulled it off!
All right... Now's our chance. Let's go, boys!
Th-this place is huge, boss...
Boss... this map is totally wrong...
Shut up... Dammit...
To think the great Earthquake got stuck with a fake map... Ah!
...Hm? I don't recognize your faces...
Pardon me, but to which knightly order do you belong?
K-knightly order?!
You too have come to Paris to fight St. Germain's demon army...
...as part of the European allied forces, I presume?
Catalonia? Norway? Perhaps Belarus?
Heh... heheh... Uh...
W-well, uh...? You... I mean, good sir?
Ain't it polite to give your own name before askin' somebody's?
...I mean, isn't it?
Ah, forgive my rudeness...
I am Neinhalt Sieger of the Drache Reich.
I-I'm... I mean, I am...
Earthquake, of the Earthquake Brigade!
Yeah, the Earthquake Brigade!
Forgive me, but I've not heard that name... Where are you from?
F-from...?
Uh, er, A-America! America!
Oh! All the way from America, across the Atlantic...
No wonder the name is new to me...
Could it be you are members of the rumored American volunteers?
Yeah, yeah! We're part of that volun-whatever!
So, like! ...No, I mean...
And so we're patrolling the palace while takin' in the sights...
Yeah, that's about it!
How fortunate. I am on patrol myself...
Would you care to join me?
I can show you around, as far as I know the place...
Is that so, GFFF... Then we'll gladly take you up on it...
(B-boss!)
(What? Shut up...)
(This is our chance! Let's run while we can!)
(GFFF...)
(You sure ain't quick on the uptake...)
(...The plan is to have this sucker give us a tour of the palace.)
(Oh, I get it... Boss, you're a genius!)
(GFFF... A ladies' man's gotta have a quick mind too.)
Is something the matter?
GFFF... Oh, no, no. My boys here are just thrilled.
Ain't that right, boys?
Yaaay, I'm so happy!
Yaaay, sightseeing, sightseeing!
Well then...
Hm?
It seems rather noisy outside...
Uh... um... Mister Giger?
About that tour...
Ah, yes, of course...
This way is a row of guest rooms...
And further back is...
You there! Who are you?!
Whaaat?!
What's with you all of a sudden?!
W-we're, uh...
Sir Lou, they are volunteers from America...
Yeah, yeah, the whatchamacallit...
Don't be fooled, Sir Sieger!
The first of the volunteers won't arrive for another week!
Wh-what...?!
Then who on earth are these men?
Tch! Well, the jig is up!
Let's scram, boys!
So long, Mister Giger!
What?! How swiftly they flee...
My apologies, Sir Lou. How careless of me...
Could they be minions of the demon army?
No, I think not.
I sensed not a shred of evil aura from them...
They must be the petty thieves causing trouble around Paris.
Still, to let mere petty thieves get inside...
Hmm... Not only the palace...
We must tighten security in all of Paris.
Curse you, St. Germain! Come if you dare!
I'll pound you with this iron fist!
Dammit... Security's been tight ever since then...
Not even a slug could squeeze in...
And there's a fabulous treasure waiting for us in there, too...
So I really can't have any ice cream?
That's right, little miss... Not unless you pay for it.
Pay...
What does pay mean?
Yes, yes, that's enough fooling around.
You're bad for business!
H-hey, now...
G... GFFFF...
Wh-what's the matter, little miss?
I... I want to eat that ice cream.
But that lady says...
I can't have it without something called money.
G... GFFFF... I-is that so... GFF
I want to eat ice cream!
Y-you want... the great me... to pay...?
You'll buy me some ice cream?!
Y... yes...
Allow me... to treat you to ice cream...
Ah, that was fun!
Oh, I know!
Mr. Earthquake, let's go play at the palace next time!
Th-the palace?
The palace is kinda iffy for little ol' me...
Huh? You don't like the palace?
GF... Folks like me ain't allowed in the palace, see...
Why not?
It's big and pretty, and the queen is ever so beautiful!
There are lots of rare things, too. It's quite fun!
Little miss...
You sure seem to know a lot about the palace...
Well, I play at the Palace of Versailles every day...
GFFF... Little miss...
Little ol' me doesn't care much for jokes...
Hee hee, you're funny, Mr. Earthquake.
I'm not joking...
Why, the queen's chambers, the grand hall, the study...
I know where every single thing is!
E-every single...
...where everything is...
She knows?!
That's right... I've already explored the whole palace.
So now I'm just bored...
Oh! You poor little miss!
GFFF... All right, little miss!
Little ol' me will come play with you!
Really?! You mean it?!
You bet! Sure as can be... GFFF...
Yay! I'm so happy! Then, to thank you for the ice cream...
next time I'll treat you!
Hey now, boss... What's gotten into you?
We ain't got time to babysit some brat!
B-boss...
D-do you have a thing for her type?
You moron! Shut your trap for a sec!
GFFF... But you know, little miss...
If we could, I'd like to sneak in without being seen...
...by those scary gatekeepers... GFFF
Of course, I understand... how you feel!
Actually, there's a secret way in and out through the palace garden!
Oh-ho... GFFF... Very good, very good...
There's a ball coming up soon. How about that day?
Balls are just boring to me anyway.
Sure thing, sure thing. GFF and F...
See you that day, then. Bye-bye!
Bye-bye!
All right! Back to the hideout, boys!
Boss... Have you finally gone soft for little girls?
Honestly... at a time this busy...
...Where on earth has Stella gone?!
Hey! Stella!
Hello! Is anyone home?!
Might you be... Master Nicotine Caffeine?
Indeed, this humble monk is Nicotine Caffeine...
And you are?
I am a ronin from Shimousa, Abiko Masaharu.
And what brings Master Abiko all the way to the Hida mountains?
I humbly beg of you!
Please, please accept me as your disciple, master!
Oh-ho... oh-ho-ho. You wish to become my disciple, eh?
Yes, sir! I know full well what a bother this is...
But I beg you... I beg you, please hear my plea...
Why would a ronin like you come seeking...
...a doddering old man like me?
In Edo, famous swordmasters run their own schools...
You could have chosen whichever style you liked.
Haohmaru and Kibagami Genjuro...
Those famed swordsmen are your top pupils, I hear...
Since I, Abiko, was born a samurai...
I wish to be known as a master of the sword!
Please take Abiko as your disciple! I beg you, Abiko begs you!
Make a man out of Abiko!
A-all right, stop shouting... This isn't a campaign speech.
Oh! Then you'll take me as your disciple?!
Now, now, now... Now, now, don't be hasty...
Tell me, who taught you the sword?
You seem quite skilled...
Under Master Makuhari Danjiro, I hold a license in Kakushin Muso style.
...But how did you know of my swordsmanship?
Watch a man's bearing, and you can roughly tell his skill.
Oh...! As expected of Master Nicotine!
...Your Master Makuhari could manage that much too...
But Kakushin Muso is a top school, renowned across Kanto...
Training more to earn full mastery would be the quicker path.
That is true.
But I want to learn real swordsmanship, not dojo fencing!
I want to walk the true way of the sword!
Hmm... Real swordsmanship, eh...
You said you were a ronin...
I have asked my lord, Matsudo Shigenao...
...for a leave of absence.
My lord kindly sent off a youth like me...
I cannot thank him enough.
So until I become your disciple and make my name as a swordsman,
I have no home to return to!
What say you, Master Nicotine!
Please allow me to become your disciple!
I may be unskilled, but...
I will never complain, no matter how harsh the training!
Please, please! I beg you! I beg you!
...Looks like you'd slit your belly if I refused...
Of course, I am prepared to!
Ah, now then...
How is it you know of Haohmaru and Genjuro?
They are both quite famous...
Hmm... That's not all, is it?
You see right through me, master...
Truth is, I once saw the two of them duel on the highway.
Inhumanly fierce sword strokes...
Unimaginable super secret techniques, one after another...
I was certain. This, this is true swordsmanship!
Mastering it is the way of the sword! A man's true calling!
Wait, wait, wait! Hold it!
You are terribly... mistaken!
And that killing intent! That spirit! That is truly...
Hm? What's that? Mistaken?
You think that using secret arts and techniques with all your might...
...to seize victory is the way of the sword, don't you?
